bindings.empty: Enable a function to start adding shortcuts.
functions.help: Enable the functions you want to use, then assign a shortcut to each one.
permissions.warning: Running without elevation. Input may be unavailable in elevated games.
receiver.empty: No paired devices. Pair a device in system Bluetooth settings first.
receiver.help: Only paired devices are shown. Open system Bluetooth settings to add a device.
receiver.timeout: The receiver is still not ready. Check the receiver Bluetooth connection.
receiver.unavailable: Bluetooth services are unavailable. Check Bluetooth settings or retry.
settings.always.admin.hint: Applies next launch. UAC is still required; cancelling continues without elevation.
settings.close.hint: When off, closing the window quits the app.
settings.connection.wait.warning.hint: After setup, warn if the receiver is not ready for over 60 seconds. Off by default.
settings.notifications.hint: Brief disconnects are cleared from the current session.
startup.description: Checking that this computer can provide Bluetooth media controls.
startup.timeout: Checks exceeded 30 seconds. Check Bluetooth and retry.
startup.troubleshooting: Enable Bluetooth and use an adapter supporting BLE peripheral mode. For folder errors, move the app to a writable folder.
test.sent: Sent. Check playback on the receiver
tray.close.hint: Still running in the background. Quit from the tray; change close behavior in Settings.
receiver.adapter.off: Bluetooth is turned off. Enable Bluetooth to discover receiver devices.
receiver.adapter.missing: No Bluetooth adapter is available. Check your adapter and Windows permissions.
receiver.scan.failed: Could not load paired devices. Try refreshing.
receiver.host.hint: On the receiver, open Bluetooth and connect to this PC. TapRelay detects its HID subscription automatically.
receiver.linked: Bluetooth connected · TapRelay session not ready
receiver.connect.failed: The receiver is not ready. Check its Bluetooth connection to this PC and try again.
receiver.disconnected: The receiver disconnected. Select it again to start a new session.
receiver.pair.wait: Complete pairing in the operating system. TapRelay is watching for the device.
receiver.pair.complete: Pairing detected. Connect on the receiver if its HID session does not start automatically.
receiver.pair.incomplete: The device is still unpaired. Choose Pair device to try again.
receiver.pair.missing: The pairing target is no longer visible. Make it discoverable and scan again.
receiver.pair.failed: Could not open pairing settings. Use Open Bluetooth settings to try again.
